reviews.title: Great 1080p monitor
reviews.comment:
Got this on intro sale. Great monitor for 130 bucks. Normal price is either 160 or 170 and I'm going to say if you're only interested in 1080p, this monitor is solid.
It seems to have built in HDR which doesn't always work with windows 11 HDR. Also, it supports free sync, but I'm AMD 26.3.1 driver, free sync shows a flicker not just on this monitor, but also an LG Ultragear 1440p, as well as a Samsung 1080p Wally world special.
Point is, flickering is most likely from the driver and not the monitor, and this monitor is high enough quality even with free sync off, there is no screen tearing for me on a mix of newer and retro games.
If you just want to know is it worth it, it is but it also is a bit flimsy. But for me, it's not a big deal because I'm not pounding like a gorilla on my desk.
